description: Immutable profile envelope, not a CaptureRequest and not directly accepted by TargetBinding.from_dict(). Shape validation is necessary but NOT sufficient for authorization or live target identity.

target_id.description: Opaque CDP ID. Preserve exact spelling; never infer from URL/title/focus.

expected_browser_id.description: First 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over UTF-8 browser WebSocket path. Mandatory in this profile.

$comment: Semantic requirements: expiry-issued is exactly 14400 seconds; issued<=now<expiry; active binding_id matches trusted current state; no revocation/supersession; clock discontinuities fail closed; live endpoint/epoch/target/count/origin/frame checks precede any content operation.
